headline: Sources: Jaxson Dart to have season-ending knee surgery
summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is expected to have season-ending knee surgery, sources told NFL Network.

headline: Ben Johnson: At this point, we're unsure of who will start at QB on Monday night

headline: Dan Quinn: No update on Jayden Daniels, who's seeing another specialist on Wednesday
summary: While Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels is out for at least this week's game against the Seahawks, there is not yet a clear timeline for his recovery.
